headline: H-Food Holdings, LLC -- Moody's assigns B2 rating to Hearthside's proposed term loan; affirms B3 CFR
summary: Moody's Investors Service ("Moody's") assigned a B2 rating to H-Food Holdings, LLC's (Hearthside) proposed $100 million senior secured first lien term loan due 2025. Concurrently, Moody's affirmed the company's B3 Corporate Family Rating (CFR) and B3-PD Probability of Default Rating (PDR). In addition, Moody's also affirmed the B2 (LGD3) ratings for the company's $225 million first lien secured revolving credit facility and $1.6 billion senior secured first lien term loan.
